card.name: Modifier right after a noun-leading phrase
card.fires_on: A modifier or first word of a noun phrase (such as newspaper, family, human, video, most) that follows a media or communication term or a verb like subtitle or record. It sits where a following noun like strips, narrative or delivery would come next.
